notes: Single episode: one run_main() call at the seed above. Rows carry `seed` so per-seed runs concatenate.
Join key is `uid` (globally unique). `veh_id` restarts at 1 per cohort and is NOT unique on its own.

The 28-dim training observation is not stored raw; it is exactly [onehot(curr_reg), onehot(dest_reg), dens_1..7, mask_1..7] (36-dim under --anticipation, with dndt_projected_1..7 + demand_phase appended).

logit_* is the UNMASKED policy-head output (pre-softmax); the greedy argmax is taken over the mask_*==1 entries only. Blank on HDV rows and on forced hops, where the agent is never called (agent_called=0).
value_estimate is the critic's V(s) at decision time -- diagnostic only, not used to pick the action.
hdvp_* is the HDV logit choice probability, blank outside the feasible set and blank on CAV rows.
decisions.csv -> vehicles.csv is a LEFT join: with --max-events, vehicles still in transit never complete and have no vehicles.csv row.
Vehicles whose origin region equals their destination region never make a routing decision and so have no decisions.csv rows at all.
